jobs.title: Structural Engineer Intern - May 2027
jobs.description:
A. Morton Thomas and Associates, Inc. (AMT) is seeking highly motivated and diverse Structural Technical Intern (STEM - Science, Technology, Engineering or Math) to join the engineering team in our Mechanicsburg, PA office for the 2027 internship period. This is a paid full-time position with anticipated duration from May through August 2027 (flexible) and has the potential to transition into a Full-Time Junior Engineer Role upon graduation. The successful candidate will work under the supervision of Project Managers and Team Leaders with partnerships with other engineering staff.
Responsibilities
Support various project tasks including regulatory requirements/reviews, cost estimates, research, procurement support, etc.;
Perform data entry, management, evaluation, and presentation;
Support the preparation of reports, plans, and specifications for clients;
May work on field assignments as needed;
Will be supported by leaders, mentors, and teammates; and
Perform other related duties and responsibilities as necessary
Minimum Requirements
Must be at least 18 years old;
Pursuing Bachelor or Associates Degree in Civil/Structural Engineering or related field;
Minimum GPA of 3.0;
Has excellent verbal and written communication skills;
Possesses solid technical and problem-solving skills;
Self-motivated, detail oriented person;
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Power Point); and
Honest, fun, hard-working and ready to learn and grow.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with engineering software applications (AutoCAD, MathCAD, Bentley Microstation, etc.) is preferred but not required.
Why Join AMT?
At AMT, we understand that our most valuable asset is our staff. For 70 years, we have worked diligently to build a team of talented employees who fully embody our values as an organization – values such as teamwork, integrity, and innovation. Now that we have transitioned into an employee-owned firm, we are excited to place the future of AMT into over 500 sets of dedicated hands.
The AMT Difference
Our company culture is characterized by a workforce that holds the highest standards of ethics and integrity, focused client care, and commitment to AMT's Core Values of safety, respect, integrity, commitment, quality, teamwork. leadership, responsibility, and profitable growth. Operating as an ESOP allows us to reward our dedicated and loyal employees with additional benefits from the company’s stock as well as an incentive to continue building a high-performance ownership culture.
To strengthen and support its employees, AMT invests in programs and processes to sustain an engaging work environment. AMT also recognizes the importance of employee benefits and policies and remains committed to providing programs that are both comprehensive and competitive in the industry.
Competitive Benefit Package
To strengthen and support its employees, its greatest asset, AMT invests in programs and processes to sustain an engaging work environment. AMT also recognizes the importance of employee benefits and policies and remains committed to providing programs that are both comprehensive and competitive in the industry. With AMT, you will get:
• Tiered medical coverage

jobs.description:

The Civil Engineering Services team is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented intern to support both engineering design and digital innovation initiatives across the SP&C Department. This role offers a unique blend of traditional civil engineering experience—including site design, grading, and infrastructure planning—with exposure to the company’s Digital Work Environment (DWE), data analytics, and insight creation efforts. The intern will gain hands-on experience using data-driven tools to enhance engineering decision-making, project efficiency, and performance tracking.​
Role Responsibilities: ​
Assist engineers in reviewing and developing civil design drawings, site plans, and grading models.​
Support data collection, processing, and analysis to improve project tracking and field performance visibility.​
Contribute to the development of dashboards and visualizations that communicate key project insights.​
Learn and apply the company’s Digital Work Environment (DWE) tools for document management, reporting, and collaboration.​
Participate in field visits to observe construction activities and validate design implementation.​
Collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams including permitting, surface land, construction, GIS, and data analytics groups.​
Document lessons learned and recommend opportunities for efficiency and data integration in civil workflows.​
​Qualifications:
Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related technical field.​
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with interest in data-driven engineering applications.​
Familiarity with AutoCAD Civil 3D, GIS, or other design software.​
Basic understanding of data visualization or analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Python preferred but not required).​
Excellent communication skills and ability to work in both technical and collaborative environments.​
Eagerness to learn about digital systems, automation, and their role in modern civil engineering.​
Selected incumbent will be placed into the position that best suits their abilities and experience level.

The Facilities Engineer Intern is a summer position designed to provide students with immersive, hands-on experience in midstream facilities engineering, design, construction, and commissioning. Working within the Facilities group, the intern will support active projects involving natural gas compression, dehydration, measurement, regulation, interconnects, and other midstream facility infrastructure. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to real-world midstream project execution, learn industry best practices, and contribute meaningfully to EQT’s facilities initiatives.
Through collaboration with experienced engineers, project managers, construction personnel, operations, and other technical disciplines, the intern will build a strong foundation in midstream facility development, project execution, and operational excellence.

Assist facilities engineering and project management teams with day-to-day technical and administrative tasks.
Support engineering design reviews, equipment and material evaluations, drawing reviews, project documentation, and construction tracking.

Help organize and maintain engineering drawings, equipment documentation, as-built records, inspection reports, and project files.
Attend team meetings and shadow field and office personnel to gain a full understanding of the facilities project lifecycle—from conceptual design and engineering through construction, commissioning, and operation.
Conduct research, engineering calculations, data analysis, or technical presentations supporting facility design, optimization, reliability, and project execution initiatives.
Learn and apply EQT’s safety protocols, engineering standards, regulatory compliance requirements, and environmental procedures.
Collaborate across engineering, construction, operations, land, permitting, compliance, supply chain, and other disciplines to understand how cross-functional teams integrate within midstream facility projects.

Demonstrated interest in midstream facilities, natural gas infrastructure, energy systems, or field operations.
Basic understanding of engineering design, process systems, mechanical equipment, or construction processes preferred.
Strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); experience with AutoCAD, process simulation, CAD/design software, or engineering data tools is a plus.

jobs.description:

If innovation and powering the future sounds exciting to you, we encourage you to apply!
Here is how the Production Engineering Intern role will impact our business:  The Production Engineering Intern will apply the knowledge and experience gained through their education in a challenging, fast-paced environment. This role will provide hands-on opportunities to strengthen both business and field operations knowledge while contributing to the overall success of the engineering team.
The Production Engineering Intern’s responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Complete daily engagements with teams and team members assigned to ensure alignment with learning targets and tasks needing to be accomplished.
Complete weekly engagements with mentor assigned to discuss experience to date and seek guidance on the next steps to ensure a successful internship.
Complete assigned milestones and targets of the internship program while rotating through the different phases of production operations (i.e. construction / pipeline installation / flowback / workover / ARO / production operations).
Work with production engineering team subject matter experts to review / understand identified API / ASME documentation and standards.
Work together as an intern team to develop and host a cross-training event for engineering and operations to highlight the in-depth understanding of a production operation concept gained through the rotation.
Complete assigned end of rotation presentation that aligns with the vision of the mentor and highlights the skills and knowledge developed while with EQT.
Required Experience and Skills:
1+ year of experience gained through collegiate schooling
Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical, chemical, petroleum engineering)
Valid driver’s license required
Willing to work in a fast-paced field and office environment with a multi-faceted team of team members.
Basic understanding of oil and gas production operations to include process flow from well bore to sales point.
Strong communication and presentation skills
Extreme Ownership Mentality
Self-starter with the ability to work independently.
Preferred Experience:
Prior internships in oil and gas industry with 2-years of schooling complete.
Advanced Microsoft Office Suite experience with an interest in Data Science.
Notes:
The selected incumbent will have the intern program tailored / adjusted based on their noted abilities and experience level.
Intern will work out of the Canonsburg office at Southpointe. Pool vehicles will be leveraged as needed for traveling to and from the field.

Intern/Co-op - Site/Civil Engineering (Spring 2027)
jobs.description:
Langan provides expert land development engineering and environmental consulting services for major developers, renewable energy producers, energy companies, corporations, healthcare systems, colleges/universities, and large infrastructure programs throughout the U.S. and around the world. Our employees collaborate seamlessly among 50+ offices and gain valuable hands-on experience that fosters career growth. Langan culture is entrepreneurial from advancing innovative technical solutions, to participating in robust training and knowledge sharing, to making progressive change within the communities we live and work.
Consistently ranked among the top ten “Best Firms to Work For” and Engineering News-Record’s top 50 firms worldwide, Langan attracts and retains the best talent in the industry. Employees thrive at Langan, a firm that fosters an inclusive and supportive work environment for all; prioritizes wellbeing, health, and safety; encourages volunteerism and philanthropy; offers workplace flexibility, along with carbon-neutral office spaces; and empowers individuals to contribute their skills and knowledge to make impactful contributions.
Job Summary
Langan is seeking an Intern/Co-op – Site/Civil Engineering to join its collaborative team in Doylestown, PA. This individual will serve a key function in supporting site feasibility studies which may involve field work, technical report preparation and calculations, pre-construction conditions documentation, design plans and specifications. In this role, you will have the opportunity to expand your knowledge and experience technically and professionally by partnering directly with industry leadership on a variety of exciting land development projects.
Job Responsibilities
Assist with the planning, design and permitting of civil engineering, land development and infrastructure projects.
Assist with the preparation and modification of various engineering documents including reports, specifications, plans, construction schedules, cost estimates and design plans for projects using engineering and design software (AutoCAD, Civil 3D, etc.) and equipment.
Effectively use reports, maps, drawings, engineering plans, tests, and aerial photographs to assess soil composition, terrain, hydrological characteristics, and topographical and geologic data and their impact on the planning and design of projects.
Support zoning, ordinance and permit assessments, assists with the sidewalk cast estimations, and determines the feasibility of projects based on the analysis of collected data.
Provide field inspection services, as needed.
Apply knowledge and techniques of engineering and advanced mathematics.
Collaborate with team members on project tasks and assignments.
Perform other duties as requested.
Qualifications
Student actively pursuing a four year or advanced degree in Civil Engineering; Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or greater is preferred;

Automation & Controls Engineer Co-op/Intern
jobs.description:
About Re:Build
At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.
We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.
The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles)
About Re:Build Optimation
At Re:Build Optimation, we specialize in delivering custom-engineered process equipment and automated systems to clients across the globe. With nearly 40 years of experience in complex chemical process systems, we have built a reputation for precision, reliability, and innovation. Our multidisciplinary team of 70+ engineers, designers, and programmers, combined with 150,000 square feet of fabrication space and over 70 skilled tradespeople, allows us to provide full turnkey solutions—from initial concept through fabrication, installation, and commissioning.
As part of Re:Build Manufacturing, we leverage the strength of a national industrial powerhouse while maintaining the agility and personalized service of a specialized firm. We serve industries ranging from traditional and green energy to chemicals, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, glass, and advanced manufacturing, offering tailored solutions that optimize efficiency and performance.
At Re:Build Optimation, we believe in a collaborative approach, working closely with our clients to develop solutions that align with their unique operational goals. Our deep industry expertise and end-to-end capabilities make us the ideal partner for companies seeking cutting-edge automation, process control, and engineered systems.
Who We Are Looking For
Re:Build Optimation is seeking an Automation & Controls Engineer Co-op/Intern who is eager to apply their engineering education to real-world industrial automation projects. You’ll work alongside engineering, design, trades, and project management teams while gaining hands-on experience supporting client-facing projects across a range of industries.
You’ll thrive in this role if you’re curious, organized, and comfortable learning through both technical problem-solving and hands-on project work. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute across the automation project lifecycle while working closely with a senior or principal engineer who will support your technical and professional development.
This opportunity is available for Spring 2027 and requires the ability to work on-site in Rochester, NY and/or Rush, NY.
What You Get To Do
Support automation projects from requirements gathering and functional specifications through design, programming, fabrication, and troubleshooting.
Develop control system architectures, P&IDs, and instrumentation and automation equipment specifications.
Create electrical drawings and schematics using AutoCAD Electrical.
Develop PLC code and configure HMI applications with guidance from experienced engineers.
Create bills of materials and support equipment and component selection.
Research and apply relevant electrical codes and standards, including NEC, NFPA 70E, and UL508A.
Support fabrication, assembly, testing, and troubleshooting activities.
Prepare technical reports, specifications, and other project documentation.
Participate in internal and client project meetings and design reviews.
Collaborate with engineers and project managers to plan and execute project tasks.
Partner with a senior or principal engineer mentor to establish and work toward technical and professional development goals.
What You Bring To The Team
Currently pursuing a BS and/or MS degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field from an accredited college or university.
Strong written and verbal communication, organization, and time-management skills.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within a project team.
Curiosity, adaptability, and an eagerness to learn.
Experience with CAD software or tools.
Ability to work on-site in Rochester, NY and/or Rush, NY.
Preferred: Experience with AutoCAD Electrical.
Preferred: Experience with PLC platforms such as Rockwell, Siemens, Beckhoff, or Schneider and/or industrial robotics.
Preferred: Previous co-op, internship, academic project, or other relevant experience supporting industrial equipment or automation engineering and design.
Preferred: Familiarity with ISO 9001, CSIA, or similar quality systems.
Preferred: Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
Preferred: Minimum 3.0 GPA.
Compensation
The hourly rate for this position is $21.00- $25.00. This range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting.  Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to hourly rate, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits
The BIG payoff
We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate.  Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!
We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate
Re:Build Manufacturing is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.
Re:Build is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations.ta@ReBuildmanufacturing.com or you may call us at 617.909.6275.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Summer Interns
jobs.description:
Watch your work come to life in landmark projects around the world when you partner with Syska Hennessy Group! As a global leader in consulting, engineering, and commissioning services, we specialize in highly technical buildings and the systems that bring them to life. We currently have opportunities for Electrical Engineering Summer Interns to join our New York, NY office.
Our dynamic work environment provides the optimal setting for a positive learning experience as an intern. From our supportive culture, diverse workforce, and competitive compensation, to our flexible work schedules and fun social events, it’s everything you’ll need for an exciting, challenging, and rewarding career.
As an intern, you will support our engineering teams working towards our designs that are inspiring, demanding and highly collaborative.  You will learn from others, and they will expect to learn from you. You will share in the responsibility, rewards, and recognition of producing truly innovative solutions and complete client satisfaction. The pace is fast and the camaraderie is close.
Some responsibilities include:
Assist engineers in preparing design documentation
Prepare AutoCAD and Revit drawings of Electrical systems
Assist engineers with design calculations and sizing building Electrical systems
Assist engineers with field investigations and construction site visits to observe
Attend intern education program lunch-and-learn sessions
Our interns will also be part of our intern education program, which consists of informational lunch-and-learn sessions that are attended by firm-wide interns. These sessions consist of various topics in our business. Interns are encouraged and expected to attend these sessions as such is crucial to their development.
Internship Requirements
The ideal candidate will enjoy a team environment and also flexible enough to work independently where needed. Candidates for this role will be eager to expand their knowledge by challenging themselves and using the highly technical resources around them.
Additional job requirements:
Pursing a bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Electrical engineering
Must be at a minimum, completed your second year
Previous engineering internship or co-op experience a huge plus
Knowledge in the latest version of MEP AutoCAD and REVIT is a plus
Basic knowledge in design and calculation software; MS Office Suite
Benefits
As an employee with Syska Hennessy Group, you will be part of a global firm with an amazing history! We are committed to being the best, to advancing engineering design practice, and to supporting our clients with integrity. To make all of that happen, we rely on the talent, drive, enthusiasm, and the total job satisfaction of the great people who work here.
Join us this summer to prepare for your career as an Engineer through our Intern Education Program. This program consists of lunch- and- learn sessions covering various aspects of our business while gaining “hands-on” experience working with our engineers and visiting project sites. Once you graduate, jump start your career by joining Syska Hennessy Group and our EDT program.
About the EDT Program
Our Company is committed to developing engineers into respected technical experts and versatile business leaders. In keeping with that aim, interns that are hired for full-time employment upon graduation can take advantage of our Engineering Development Training (EDT) program; an accelerated, but thorough training curriculum. This curriculum will teach not only the technical aspects of our profession but industry-specific business aspects as well.
